description: Skip time is a simple but useful mod for Minecraft that gives players more control over the passage of time. With this mod, you can control time with a single keystroke.
body: # Skip time Skip time is a simple but useful mod for Minecraft that gives players more control over the passage of time. Tired of waiting for morning to come or spending long hours waiting for the right moon phase? With this mod, you can control time with a single keystroke. Key features: Speed up gameplay to quickly skip through the night or wait for the right moment. Built-in interface (HUD) that shows the exact game time in real time. No more guessing how long until dawn! We plan to add flexible settings in the configuration file so you can adapt the mod to your needs. ⚠️ Development status: The mod is in active development. This means that: 1) Bugs or bugs are possible. 2) The functionality will be expanded. 3) I would love to hear your feedback and suggestions for improvement!
